description: This file defines the KeyboardExtension class, which extends AddOnImpl, representing a keyboard extension with properties such as type and resource ID, including validation and accessor methods.

classes.name: KeyboardExtension
classes.description: Represents a keyboard extension with specific type and resource ID, extending AddOnImpl.

classes.name: KeyboardExtension.KeyboardExtensionType
classes.description: Annotation interface defining valid extension types: BOTTOM, TOP, EXTENSION.

methods.name: KeyboardExtension
methods.description: Constructor initializing a KeyboardExtension with context, resource ID, type, and other metadata.

methods.name: ensureValidType
methods.description: Static method validating the extension type, returning it if valid or throwing an exception.

methods.name: getKeyboardResId
methods.description: Returns the resource ID of the keyboard associated with this extension.

methods.name: getExtensionType
methods.description: Returns the type of the extension (bottom, top, or extension).
